entries.en:
What's new in 6.27.0

- NEW: In-app updates. AutoPlayer now checks the Play Store for a new version on startup and lets you install it right away, or check manually under "About".
- Party mode: clearer guest feedback when the request limit is reached, plus an in-party settings panel (max requests / cooldown) and a karaoke toggle fix.
- Sharing hub: real platform audio export (render & share) with per-platform length limits and a hardened render dialog.
- Various stability and wiring fixes across the settings screens.

What's new in 6.26.0

- Paywall localized into 24 additional languages.
- Numerous bug fixes and polish across the app.
